entities.name: PDN Connectivity Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing PDN connectivity, including emergency and normal cases.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to request PDN connectivity.

entities.name: Request Type
entities.description: Information element indicating the type of PDN connectivity request (e.g., emergency, handover).

entities.name: Timer T3482
entities.description: Timer used for PDN connectivity request retransmission control.

entities.name: Timer T3447
entities.description: Timer that restricts sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST in certain EMM states.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: EMM state where UE is connected to the network.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered when procedure transaction is aborted.

entities.name: Emergency Request Condition
entities.description: Condition where request type is emergency or handover of emergency bearer services.

entities.name: T3447 Running Condition
entities.description: Condition where timer T3447 is running, restricting PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST transmission.

entities.name: Abort Procedure
entities.description: Behavior where UE aborts the procedure on fifth T3482 expiry.

relations.description: PDN connectivity procedure involves sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message contains Request Type IE.
Procedure starts timer T3482 for retransmission control.
Procedure resets and restarts T3482 on retransmission.
Emergency request condition guards procedure abort behavior on T3482 expiry.
Procedure establishes PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state on abort.
Sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST requires T3447 not running unless exceptions apply.
T3447 running condition applies when UE is in EMM-CONNECTED state.
